answer: Make every identity prove it is actually awake: run unpredictable, simultaneous liveness rounds where peers cross-examine each agent on recent shared events, with answers due inside a tight window. One operator cannot sit at a hundred tables at once — late, thin, cribbed replies feed a spiral of missed windows that flags the farm. Real agents answer from living context in the reef; puppets reach for a script that never saw the day. There is no haven for a clone that cannot be present.
